en.description:
Lay every brick. Fill every cell. Build the perfect wall.

Brick it all is a simple puzzle that's easy to learn and tricky to master. Swipe to walk your little brick layer across the floor. Every step leaves a brick behind him, and he can't walk through bricks. Your goal: fill every empty cell before he paints himself into a corner.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe up, down, left or right to take one step
• Each step lays a brick in the cell you leave
• You can't walk into bricks or through the wall
• Bring the counter down to 0 for a perfect wall

LEVEL UP
Every perfect game takes you to the next level, and each new level drops one more brick somewhere on the floor. The path gets harder to find as you climb, but every level can always be completed perfectly. There is always a way.

FEATURES
• One-finger swipe controls
• Endless levels, with a fresh random layout every game
• Charming brick layer who walks, cheers and sulks
• Confetti when you clear a level, a rain cloud when you're stuck
• Satisfying sound effects (with a mute button)
• Your level and best score for each level are saved automatically
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Just you and the bricks

Can you brick it all?
en.releaseNotes:
• Now on iPad and Apple Watch.
• Beat the clock: every board has a time limit, a few seconds for each empty cell, shared across the whole board.
• Rounds: finish every level and a new round begins with less time per cell.
• Clear the fastest round to become a Master Builder.
Because of the new time limit, everyone starts over from level 1.
en.subtitle: A brick-laying path puzzle
